status: prototype rejected; production code and accounting expectations restored
hypothesis: Use the last known blocking rectangle to reject frontier nodes before decimal ranking and bucket insertion, while still advancing and charging every frontier node.
prototype: In Occupancy::place_near_impl, before occupancy_frontier_key1dp, call indexed_conflict using rejection.obstacle and its optional child geometry. Skip only bucket insertion for proven collisions. Retain heap successors and flush, frontier node limits and all acceptance predicates.

correctness.new_retained_property_test: 27 combinations of obstacle/query face masks and anchors; independently enumerate legal lattice positions with exhaustive collision checking, sort by distance/x/y, compare complete results and bounded-search prefixes. Assert rejected nodes still consume the ten-node frontier limit.

measurements.workload: 163x151 carrier, options from 2026-10-15-current-escape-corridors.json qualification, compact-stage profiler, observer enabled, same schematic and authored floorplan; construction only, not full acceptance
measurements.initial_caveat: Other local builds/tests overlapped; not used to infer speedup.
measurements.serial_conditions: Two runs each, same process prepared inputs reused, prototype followed by restored baseline; no intentionally overlapping task tests/builds during serial runs. OS caches and external host activity uncontrolled; small sample.

decision: Ranking calls fell approximately 39%, but serial model times are effectively unchanged. Do not retain additional per-node predicate complexity without a demonstrated throughput gain. Operation counts are not a substitute for measured performance.
next_direction: Profile heap/frontier traversal and candidate-domain volume; seek removal of whole provably impossible regions or repeated queries rather than adding a second collision probe per node.
